- **Common_rust**: Larger, oval/elongated, brick-red to dark brown pustules on both leaf surfaces, more scattered; late-stage shows dark dense pustules with gray leaf damage
- **Southern_rust**: Smaller, rounder, bright orange pustules, very dense, typically concentrated on upper leaf surface
